source: OECD PISA 2022 Results (Volume I), Annex B1 Chapter 7 tables I.B1.7.17 (mathematics), I.B1.7.21 (reading), I.B1.7.25 (science) and I.B1.7.29 (mathematics by language spoken at home)

outcomes.maths: immigrant minus non-immigrant mean mathematics score, score points
outcomes.homeLanguage: WITHIN immigrant students only: mean of those who SPEAK the language of assessment at home, minus those who do NOT. Positive means speaking the test language at home is an advantage. A language gap rather than an immigration one, and it holds immigrant status constant.

caveats: Mathematics was the major domain in PISA 2022; reading and science are minor domains and less precisely measured.
Taken from the StatLink workbook, NOT the PDF: pdftotext misaligns these tables, offsetting the difference column from the score columns and blanking alternate rows.
